early_frame_definition: 0 <= t < 60; no threshold selection or fitting of new detector
outcome: per-box ShootingRules hit from already max-fused official cached probabilities, not official merged-component Pd
residual_definition: 90th percentile absolute difference between the two half-window median images after removing global offset; 4x4 block means, high-gradient pixels, shared valid mask
ownership: Nearest source-window center among covering windows; strict tie goes to earlier window. Each target counted once. owned_first/last in M1 CSV refers only to labelled target times.
association_method: Unit=owned window miss rate; unweighted Pearson and pooled Spearman. Clip-intercepts and clip+early-owner indicator removed by least squares from both variables. No p values, CI, causal interpretation or independent-window assumption.

limitations: Local diagnostic on17 previously missed annotated target-frames of one clip.
Additional global false alarms, full-frame false alarms and whole-test benefit were not evaluated.
Changing window placement changes both temporal context and relative output index; those mechanisms remain inseparable here.
This is the same frozen official detector; no appearance model or training was used.
